title: Verified Stallings folding for finitely generated subgroups of F2
abstract: Constructs a finite inverse automaton recognizing the subgroup generated by any finite list of signed words in the rank-two free group. Proves exact subgroup preservation and correctness of canonical reduced-word membership testing. Reusable infrastructure includes inverse-automaton walks, reduction-compatible traversal, finite fold congruences, coset potentials, flower graphs, and basis roses. Folding uses exhaustive finite search over Boolean relations; no complexity bound, core pruning, subgroup basis, intersection, or index algorithm is claimed.

informal.Stallings.folded_recognizer_exists: For every finite list S of signed words on two generators, there exist a finite type of states, a base state, and a partial transition table with inverse-labelled reverse edges, such that traversing the canonical reduced word of any g in FreeGroup (Fin 2) returns to the base exactly when g lies in the subgroup generated by the word values in S. The witness is the computed flower-graph fold.
informal.Stallings.foldWords_loopSubgroup_eq_gene: For every finite input list of signed words in the rank-two free group, the based-loop subgroup of the computed folded flower graph equals the subgroup generated by the input words.
informal.Stallings.foldedMembershipTest_eq_true_i: For any finite generating list S and any rank-two free-group element g, the executable folded-automaton test returns true if and only if g belongs to the subgroup generated by S. There is no efficiency guarantee for constructing the automaton.
